from pathlib import Path
import json, sqlite3, subprocess, urllib.request, urllib.error
sha='ffce4de2adf9cd34330b18cc32d06cb9644b1809'
base='94a51213fda238afe496f0546144e7e642329f77'
marker='family-bulletin-sandy-20260713T225254Z-ffce4de'
r=Path('receipt.md')
assert r.is_file() and r.stat().st_size>1200, 'receipt.md missing or too small'

for token in ['Verdict','PASS',marker,'notes-io59y.2.1','JAC-3366','19d7c8f2-da44-48e6-b448-e308852d4d64',sha,'127.0.0.1:8082','Rollback']:

changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','--git-dir=/Users/hermes/git/agentic-os.git','diff','--name-only',base+'..'+sha],text=True).splitlines()
assert changed==['command-centre/src/app/(gallery)/bulletin/bulletin-board.tsx','command-centre/src/lib/family-bulletin-sandy.test.cjs'], changed
def ssh(command, timeout=120):
    return subprocess.check_output(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=8','talaris',command],text=True,timeout=timeout)
assert ssh('git -C /Users/jack.reis/Projects/wt-deploy-sandy-ffce4de rev-parse HEAD').strip()==sha
assert ssh('git -C /Users/jack.reis/Projects/wt-deploy-sandy-ffce4de status --porcelain').strip()==''

assert '127.0.0.1:8082' in listen and '*:8082' not in listen, listen
for path in ['/api/health','/api/tasks','/api/cron/system-status','/bulletin']:
    code=ssh(f"curl -sS -o /tmp/ringer-probe -w '%{{http_code}}' http://127.0.0.1:8082{path}").strip()
    assert code=='200', (path,code)
body=ssh("curl --resolve talaris.tailc2f398.ts.net:443:100.97.178.76 -fsS https://talaris.tailc2f398.ts.net/dashboard/bulletin")
assert 'Sandy' in body and 'sploot' in body.lower()
rc=subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','talaris','curl --connect-timeout 3 -fsS http://100.97.178.76:8082/bulletin'],capture_output=True,text=True).returncode
assert rc!=0, 'direct tailnet port unexpectedly open'
for url in ['https://gallery.jack.digital/family-bulletin','https://gallery.jack.digital/gallery/sandy/sandy-pet.png','https://cortex.jack.digital/bulletin','https://cortex.jack.digital/gallery/sandy/sandy-pet.png']:

        urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=15); code=200
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:

    assert code in (401,403,404),(url,code)
con=sqlite3.connect('/Users/hermes/.bifrost/logs.db')
row=con.execute('select provider,model,status,total_tokens from logs where id=?',('19d7c8f2-da44-48e6-b448-e308852d4d64',)).fetchone(); con.close()
assert row and row[2]=='success' and row[3]>0,row
comments=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/issues/JAC-3366/comments',timeout=10))
assert marker.lower() in json.dumps(comments).lower()
